searchText: Oh actually, I'm not sure I can make that time. I miscalculated, and it's right in the worst possible slot on a friday evening (and it's 95 minutes!?) We can move it, I am fine with that. It may also be useful to do some pre-discussion about what this call is supposed to be about and what everyone wants to get from it I do not have any agenda for it, so I will not be "driving" the meeting, but I am happy to participate if it is helpful The previous discussion we had had was about trying to give an overview of each of our approaches and especially some of the edge cases / tricky bits. Not sure 90 mins is needed, happy to change the duration. Perhaps it's worth it for each team to post a written summary of what they are working on beforehand so that others can get up to speed, if they have one? I know Geth had this article: https://blog.ethereum.org/2020/07/17/ask-about-geth-snapshot-acceleration As for the time, does 14:00 UTC work better? Ok, so it is probably ok if I cannot join. Then perhaps you can move it back to the original time, 14:00 UTC this Friday, and I will try to join, but if I can't, I can't
